rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=214, train_n=0, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=120, tv_lr=0.01, tv_clip_max=0.1, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=tv_iterative iter-9 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). BASE_ITER=4 (the BEST, hr 0.208547: clip 0.08, lambda 0.001, lr 0.01, but 160 iters @1227s breached the HARD 1200s wall). ONE LIVE KNOB: tv_clip_max 0.08->0.10 (PUSH PAST the top of the solver search bound [0.03,0.08]); tv_iterations reverted 160->120 (the budget-proven count: iter-2/3/5/7 @120 landed 910-972s; iter-4 @160 was OVER the wall). The four live knobs in tv_reconstruction are tv_lambda/tv_iterations/tv_lr/tv_clip_max; the clamp is a hard upper f.clamp_(0.0, clip_max) applied EVERY GD step, truncating every voxel mu>clip_max. LEVER MAP (all four live knobs): clip was THE lever (iter-1 0.05->iter-2 0.08 lifted hr 0.133->0.205, +0.072, by un-truncating high-mu bone) but has only been probed UP TO the search-box ceiling 0.08, NEVER beyond it; lambda BRACKETED at optimum 0.001 (up@0.003 iter-3 0.1366, down@0.0005 iter-6 0.1582 both regress); lr BRACKETED (up-2x@0.02 iter-5 0.1873 overshoot, up-1.3x@0.013 iter-7 0.2082 flat); iters 120(918s)/140(1064s)/160(1227s, OVER WALL) -- 160 gave the peak 0.2085 but is wall-illegal, the budget-safe band <=140 caps at ~0.208 within noise. GENUINELY UNTRIED: the clip lever ABOVE its bound. FAILURE MODE: at clip_max=0.08 the hard clamp may STILL truncate the highest-mu bone/contrast voxels (real Mayo LDCT mu exceeds 0.08), a direct uncredited RMSE penalty on the RMSE-sensitive headroom metric. HYPOTHESIS: raising tv_clip_max 0.08->0.10 lets the remaining mu in [0.08,0.10] bone voxels through, dropping val_rmse below iter-4 7.825e-4 so hr rises above the BEST 0.208547 at ZERO extra compute -- exactly the mechanism that drove the iter-1->2 jump, extended one step further. PREDICTED iter-9 hr ~0.211 (if the clamp is still binding) -- modest, since most of the bone was already recovered at 0.08. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.208547 (no gain), the 0.08 clamp already passes ALL real Mayo attenuation (no voxels live in [0.08,0.10]), the clip lever is FULLY exhausted, and ALL FOUR live levers are spent (clip un-binding above 0.08, lambda bracketed, lr bracketed, iters budget-capped) -- 0.2085 hr / ~0.927 SSIM is the STRUCTURAL classical-TV FBP-ceiling on dense (2304-view) real Mayo LDCT; STOP tuning tv_iterative toward iter-20. BUDGET: tv_clip_max is a ZERO marginal-compute knob at the budget-proven tv_iterations=120 -> cost model 31.8+120*7.47=928s (77 pct of the 1200s wall, ~272s margin; +10 pct GPU-contention variance ~1018s, still under). val = ALL 214 L277 slices unchanged. sbatch --time=00:30:00 SLURM safety net above the 20-min metric-validity budget.
